selection_policy.signal_family: frozen V4.5.3/b022, with a small predeclared neighborhood check
selection_policy.rule: Require positive CAGR in every historical fold and historical drawdown no more than one percentage point worse than the V4.6.1 control; select the simplest candidate within 0.15 score points of the best historical score after Sharpe dispersion and monthly-volatility penalties. The diagnostic window is reported only.

limitations: Historical data were already visible during research; the diagnostic window is not a blind out-of-sample proof.
The primary replay uses five-minute OHLC execution and all-Taker fills.
The cached public funding history begins on 2026-06-27; earlier settlements are not fabricated.
Month-to-date controls use the completed hourly BTC close as a causal risk budget proxy.
